limits: CI approval applies to 8262da2 and the configured workflow; later documentation commits are not retrospectively validated.
tests/identity_security T13/T15 remain local evidence; the approved workflow does not invoke that suite.
Deployment uses published 1.0.0 images by digest, not the newly built CI images.
No new Docker Hub publication and no Sonar Quality Gate approval are claimed.
No complete ZAP staging or real SMTP acceptance is performed by these workflows.
